card.name: Blood count thresholds in dose rules
card.fires_on: The word "absolute" just before neutrophil or lymphocyte count in dose-modification rules. It also fires on the comma inside platelet numbers like 75,000 and on the T or c inside QT/Torsade terms.

modes.label: Absolute before cell count
modes.description: The word absolute (or Absolute) leading into neutrophil or lymphocyte count thresholds.

modes.label: Comma in platelet number
modes.description: The thousands comma in a platelet count threshold.

modes.description: A letter inside QTc or Torsade, in cardiac dose-change criteria.
modes.example: higher occurrence of<< T>>orsade de Pointes.
